basic_info.description: Available for the first time in thirty years, this historic Dolores Heights home showcases an abundance of Victorian-era charm and craftsmanship. Features include tall ceilings, crown molding, hardwood and original softwood floors, and natural light throughout. The main level boasts a large living room with gas-burning fireplace and a mantle adorned with Victorian tiles, a formal dining room with built-in shelving and cabinetry, a bedroom with ensuite full bath, and finally, a large eat-in kitchen with French doors that open up to an adjoining deck. On the upper level, a grand staircase leads you to the other three bedrooms, an additional office/media room, and a full bath. Outside you'll find an expansive backyard accented by paved brickwork, tasteful landscaping, and an enchanting greenhouse. A perfect place for entertaining, gardening, or just peaceful relaxation; all on an oversized lot. The house also includes a large basement with a storage room. Additional highlights include stainless steel appliances, washer and dryer, and a Nest thermostat. Just outside your door, you'll find yourself a mere 6 minute walk from Mission Dolores Park, as well as walking distance to the Castro, Noe Valley and Mission neighborhoods. Walk Score of 94!
